    Everything else in the container — including the entire ~/.hermes/ directory — lives on the container's writable overlay filesystem. The worker can:
    
    - Edit ~/.hermes/config.yaml — remove the hook, change the model, disable enforcement
    - Edit ~/.hermes/.env — swap API keys, add new providers
    - Edit ~/.hermes/plugins/mwl-proof/init.py — neuter the hook logic

    - Alter ~/.hermes/sessions/ — rewrite history
